description.en: Reproducibility evidence for DeepSeek Harness: a bounded read-only scan records git commit and dirty state, dependency lockfiles, environment pins, input-data hashes, figures, notebooks, seeds and runnable commands, derives gap severities, and compares a recorded manifest against the current tree.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的可复现证据：有界只读扫描记录 git 提交与脏状态、依赖锁、环境固定、输入数据哈希、图、Notebook、随机种子与可运行命令，推导缺口等级，并对比记录清单与当前树。
